fire: Our bus finally reached Cuenca, a town built above two river gorges.
His grandfather studied at the university in Czernowitz before the war.
Archaeologists dug for decades at Cnossos on the island of Crete.

The museum owns a fine Coptic textile from the sixth century.

Roman legions marched from Antioch toward Ctesiphon on the Tigris.
